calls.reason: R2I-Bench says image models improved in photorealism while reasoning stays weak. But no source tracks both kinds of gain over the same years, so the claim about rates of improvement is unmeasured.
Only Marcus's own post describes his first Nano Banana attempt. No independent session record or authenticated output was found to confirm it was his first try or that it failed.
One launch-week test of four prompts had two failures and two successes. Google's own note on limitations is broader. That is too thin to show repeated compositional failures across frontier models.
No matched test of Nano Banana against ChatGPT on bicycles or mechanical drawings was retrieved. Google's top editing rating measures something else, so the comparison cannot be judged.

Davis's July 2025 retest found ChatGPT much improved, though it still failed some tasks. No readable August test of anatomical errors was found, so the evidence neither confirms nor rules out the claim.
